name: subagent-fleet
description: Runs several coding agents at once on shared repositories without losing work or trust: one worktree and test database per agent, a brief with local-only commits and stop-on-block, steering and resuming background subagents, background tasks and timeouts, landing agent commits by exact paths and fast-forward only, transcripts as the record, and read-only scripts that inventory leftover worktrees, branches and processes and search session transcripts.
